summary_en: This phase II study tests capmatinib and osimertinib, with or without ramucirumab, in non-small cell lung cancer that is advanced and has EGFR and MET gene changes. Capmatinib and osimertinib are taken by mouth, and ramucirumab is given through a vein; how often and for how long are not stated. The record does not state the main outcome measure; this is a phase II study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II prueba capmatinib y osimertinib, con o sin ramucirumab, en cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado con cambios en los genes EGFR y MET. Capmatinib y osimertinib se toman por vía oral, y ramucirumab se administra por vena; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican en el registro. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; este es un estudio de fase II.
who_for: Advanced or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer with a sensitizing EGFR mutation
Disease progressed on osimertinib, which was the most recent line of therapy
MET amplification found by a qualifying next generation sequencing test after osimertinib progression
Measurable or non-measurable disease documented by CT or MRI
Zubrod performance status 0 to 1, with blood counts and organ function within set limits
not_for: Prior treatment with an anti-VEGF, VEGFR, or MET inhibitor
Anti-cancer drug other than osimertinib within 21 days before randomization
Radiation therapy within 14 days or major surgery within 14 days before randomization
Certain interacting drugs within 7 days before registration, or uncontrolled blood pressure
